section: Executive summary: five things leaders need to know
claim_as_written: 4. The entry path is the risk to watch. It is a hypothesis with a mechanism, not yet a finding. Formation (the supervised repetition that turns a novice into a practitioner) is squeezed from two directions. In federal land agencies and conservation corps, personnel, hiring and grant decisions are removing entry jobs now. AI and sensors could compress the tasks juniors learned on; their actual use inside agencies is unmeasured. Meanwhile long-tenured staff are leaving: the roughly 2,000 EPA employees who left at the end of 2025, mostly through deferred-resignation retirements, had a median 30.3 years of service, against 10.8 years for those who stayed.

claim_as_written: Figures. F01–F10 are CSV datasets built by the figure script published with this report. The script checks key values against their verification records and fails if one of those records changes, is withdrawn or is marked superseded; it does not check every cell. The plan-document figures (F05 and F06) use bootstrap confidence intervals and include the sensitivity checks described in section 3.1, computed from a plan-level extract of the OpenLMP corpus. Their rows are labeled by the 95% interval of the 2012-rule minus 1982-rule difference: a difference whose interval includes zero is "not distinguishable", whether or not the two rules' own intervals overlap. The figures index gives each figure's headline, suggested chart form, source note, use tier and evidence label. Charts carry a data table and a text message, with no hover-only information or color-only encoding.
